trades.name: RCAT
trades.why: The reason to own it is gone (the $150-180M revenue target withdrawn after an $11.8M quarter, 0.6% gross margin) and a share sale is close to forced by a cash bid for Steyr that takes nearly all its cash; target cuts and tax-loss selling come before any good news that has a date.
trades.wrong_if: Red Cat announces a funded Ukraine order or shipment, a US contract award of $25M or more, or that it is dropping or cutting back the Steyr bid, inside the window.

trades.name: ACM
trades.why: The report after the close shows the two problem construction projects on schedule and budget, record design margins and backlog and a 2027 profit guide at or a little above consensus, on a stock at about 12 times earnings that fell for a year on exactly that problem; up 6.8% after-hours on steady trading and holding.
trades.wrong_if: On the 11-17 call or in a filing inside the window management discloses a further charge, cost overrun or schedule slip on either legacy Construction Management project, lowers the FY2027 guide, or withdraws the long-term margin or EPS targets; or two or more covering brokers downgrade after the call.

trades.name: Payroll and HR software
trades.why: The four payroll processors earn interest on client cash and are paid per paycheck, so a Fed about to hike with hiring holding raises their earnings while it cuts the multiple of the rest of software; three of the four just beat and raised. Workday is left out: it holds no client cash, is the AI-exposed one, and reports on 11-24.
trades.wrong_if: The pricing of a 12-9 hike falls below about 60% (CME FedWatch) on data or Fed speech inside the window, or the FOMC minutes on 11-18 read as leaning against a hike; or one of ADP, PAYX, PAYC, PCTY warns on client employment or float income.

trades.name: HUBS
trades.why: The co-founder came back as CEO on 11-12 and on 11-13 bought $5M of stock at 217, paying about $450K in short-swing penalties to do it; the stock then rose open to close on 1.6x volume on a day the market fell 1.9%, and his promised post on the plan is still to come.
trades.wrong_if: HubSpot lowers or withdraws its Q4 or full-year guidance, announces another senior departure beyond Rangan and Bueker or a dilutive deal, or Halligan's plan is published and two or more covering brokers downgrade on it, inside the window.

trades.name: Coatings and specialty chemicals
trades.why: Since the Iran war the paint makers trade inversely to oil, their price increases are in and oil has fallen about a quarter in a month and again tonight; the fund on the other side is weighed down by miners with metals falling and the dollar at a 19-month high.
trades.wrong_if: The Hormuz reopening talks collapse or shipping through the strait is hit again so that crude jumps 8% or more in a session, or Sherwin-Williams, PPG or Ecolab cuts guidance (including Ecolab lowering targets at its 11-17 investor day), inside the window.

trades.name: AGNC
trades.why: A leveraged holder of mortgage bonds trading at about 1.1 times a book value that is a month old and shrinking, while its peer Annaly trades at about book; mortgage bonds fell 1.5 points last week with no buyers, the Fed is about to hike again, and it lost its 52-week closing low this morning.
trades.wrong_if: AGNC publishes a book value at or above its mid-October mark (about $7.25) or announces a buyback; or mortgage bonds are reported outperforming Treasuries over a week (Mortgage News Daily or the like); or the pricing of a 12-9 hike falls below about 75% on data, the 11-18 minutes or Fed speech, inside the window.

trades.name: BILL
trades.why: The FT reports TPG is nearing a take-private that could be agreed in the coming days, at a company three activists have pushed to sell for a year; the stock is up only 9% on it, which prices a lot of doubt, and the close before the report rested on a strong quarter rather than on the rumor.
trades.wrong_if: BILL, TPG or a major outlet (FT, Bloomberg, Reuters, WSJ) says the talks have ended or stalled; or a deal is announced at or below about $62 a share; or the 11-20 close passes with no agreement and no fresh report that talks continue.
